title: Remove Duplicates from Sorted List
description: Remove all duplicate elements from a sorted linked list so each appears only once.
pseudocode:
1. current = head
2. while current != null and current.next != null:
3.   if current.val == current.next.val:
4.     current.next = current.next.next
5.   else:
6.     current = current.next

steps.note: Initialize current pointer to the head of the list.
Compare current node value (1) with next node value (1). They are equal.
Remove the duplicate by pointing current.next to current.next.next.
Compare current node value (1) with next node value (2). They are different.
Move current pointer to next node.

fullDescription:
Given the head of a sorted linked list, delete all duplicates such that each element appears only once. Return the linked list sorted as well.

 

Example 1:

Input: head = [1,1,2]
Output: [1,2]

Example 2:

Input: head = [1,1,2,3,3]
Output: [1,2,3]

 

Constraints:

  • The number of nodes in the list is in the range [0, 300].
  • -100 <= Node.val <= 100
  • The list is guaranteed to be sorted in ascending order.
